atk.doc: Attack: each point over the target's Defence adds 5% to its damage, up to +150%.

dmg.doc: Damage: what one troop takes off a target at an even Attack and Defence (combat.md §7).

def.doc: Defence: each point over the attacker's Attack takes 2.5% off the damage, down to −75%.

speed.doc: How far it walks in one tick, in field units — a slot is 100 across (combat.md §10).

range.doc: How near its target it must stand to strike, centre to centre, in field units (combat.md §8).

minBuildingLevel.doc: The level its hall must stand at before this rank can be trained (combat.md §6.1).

evolutions.doc: Ranks II to V, in order: every number authored whole. The ladder (×1.6 dmg·hp·power, +2 atk·def, ×2 cost, ×1.5 time a rank) is a balancing rule, not a formula (combat.md §6.2).
